internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: In 2022 we opened two new stores, Sliema and Burmarrad. On the 1st of December 2022, we inaugurated a new €3 million logistics centre in Burmarrad. The very efficient and environmentally friendly business premises handles Lidl’s storage and distribution. It covers an expanse of 14,900 square meters and aims to raise Lidl's storage capacities in Malta as well as to upgrade its business operations.
